#### Things to do this week

#### Notes on the Resources

Review ALL the resources above. Here are some additional notes:
    
[Learn SQL joins](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-11-learn-sql-joins) Another one of those cool Decomplexify videos.  Enjoy!


[Keys made easy](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-11-keys-made-easy) You've seen this before, but its a good reminder of Keys.


[Intro to joins](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-11-intro-to-joins) a quick intro to joins - worth your time.


[Joins - Part 1](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-11-joins-part-1) First of 2 on SQL.  Enjoy the entire series! https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLi01XoE8jYojRqM4qGBF1U90Ee1Ecb5tt


[Joins - Part 2](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-11-joins-part-2) Second of 2 on SQL.  Enjoy the entire series! https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLi01XoE8jYojRqM4qGBF1U90Ee1Ecb5tt


[Database constraints](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-11-database-constraints) Insights into the why and how of database constraints.


[Foreign key constraints](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-11-foreign-key-constraints) More on foreign key constraints.


[SAVE YOU HOURS™](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-save-you-hours) Yes - I need to say it again.


[11 SQL Questions](https://medium.com/@ritika_DataAnalyst/11-practical-sql-interview-questions-i-failed-to-answer-during-an-interview-f3a40205ddff) is a fun reference on questions you might get asked about SQL for a job interview!  Hopefully, you'll know how to answer these questions by the end of the semester!


[History of SQL](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-11-history-of-sql) I ran across this link.  Interesting in a nerdish kind of way!
